title: NBI — Zanageen | TVC Concept & Treatment
summary: A proposed 60-second television commercial developed for the National Bank of Iraq. The concept centres on Mr. Jawad, a character representing experience, wisdom, and reassurance. Through a series of business situations, the narrative explores the challenges faced by Iraqi entrepreneurs and the importance of having a dependable financial partner. The creative treatment establishes the narrative structure, character direction, visual approach, and intended cinematic language of the proposed film.

meta.title: NBI — Zanageen | TVC Concept & Treatment | Rafat Mhalla
meta.description: A proposed 60-second NBI television commercial: a concept and creative treatment developed by Rafat Mhalla and Mohammad Jalal through Vision House.

blocks.body: Creative and Art Direction by Mohammad Jalal & Rafat Mhalla · Creative Development — Vision House · 60 sec · Proposed

Businesses of different sizes face distinct operational and financial challenges.

From everyday transactions and delayed payments to financing and business expansion, these obstacles can affect progress at every stage.

The creative challenge was to bring these different experiences together within one clear, relatable narrative.

Mr. Jawad serves as the connecting character throughout the film.

His calm presence contrasts with the tension experienced by the business owners around him.

As the narrative progresses, the character becomes a symbol of reassurance, helping connect the individual stories to the campaign's central message.

blocks.heading: 01 · Restaurant
blocks.body:
A busy, cramped restaurant. The cashier is overwhelmed by cash. Mr. Jawad stands still in the crowd.

VO (EN): "Some struggle to take payments, losing time, losing customers."

blocks.heading: 02 · Importer / Exporter
blocks.body:
A warehouse with half-empty shelves and a truck waiting outside. Mr. Jawad watches silently at the end of a shelf.

VO (EN): "Some can't ship their goods. Deals stop before they start."

blocks.heading: 03 · Old Office
blocks.body:
A finance office buried in paperwork. Mr. Jawad observes from the hall.

VO (EN): "Some are trapped in old ways. Slow work, slow results."

blocks.heading: 04 · Government Project
blocks.body:
A construction site frozen, machines silent. Mr. Jawad watches from a distance.

VO (EN): "Some projects wait for the money to move forward."

blocks.heading: 05 · Luxury Office
blocks.body:
A high-floor boardroom. The owner stares at unpaid contracts while others leave. Mr. Jawad remains seated, then stands and looks directly at camera.

Mr. Jawad (direct, EN): "Money is the lifeblood of business — from the smallest shop to the biggest deal."

Working alongside Mohammad Jalal through Vision House, I contributed to the creative and art direction of the proposed commercial.

Our work focused on developing the central idea, character, narrative structure, and visual treatment.

The creative development included scriptwriting, storyboarding, and establishing the intended cinematic language for the individual scenes.
